fields.statement: QA at c20429608, built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch repo with a hand-written plan run journal (builtin plan.toml definition), RHIZA_RUN set: rhiza run findings with a change-set depends-on link ID (also by 12-char prefix), a model depends-on link ID and a node recorded the round (exit 0); text and run status --json showed link, link_type depends-on, link_from and link_to; run verdict confirmed the link finding; round-3 run review-check added question review-…-r3-f1 naming 'link depends-on <id> from <a> to <b>' with links_in and links_out empty; an ID that is neither node nor link exited 2 with the journal unchanged.

QA at c20429608, built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch repo with a hand-written plan run journal (builtin plan.toml definition), RHIZA_RUN set: run findings recorded 3 findings and run verdict confirmed f1 and dropped f2,f3; run status --json and its markdown showed the round with its findings and verdicts; an unknown ID exited 2 with nothing written.

QA at c20429608, built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch repo with a hand-written plan run journal (builtin plan.toml definition), RHIZA_RUN set: after a revise visit with no later round, run review-check and run review-check --fresh both exited 3 naming round 1 as predating the latest revise and wrote nothing; with rounds journaled after each revise, --fresh exited 0 and review-check judged as before (round 2 fail exit 1, round 3 pass adding a question). workflow describe plan shows critic on.pass -> fresh, fresh on.pass -> check, on.fail -> review; plan-milestone.toml has the same.

QA at c20429608, built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch repo with a hand-written plan run journal (builtin plan.toml definition), RHIZA_RUN set: at review visit 1 run round-recorded exited 3 naming rhiza run findings; after run findings it exited 0; at review visit 2 the earlier round did not count (exit 3). With a review-step session record, session done exited 3 naming rhiza run findings and left the session not done; after an empty {"findings":[]} round, session done exited 0.

QA at c20429608, built binary (go build -trimpath) in a scratch repo with a hand-written plan run journal (builtin plan.toml definition), RHIZA_RUN set: rhiza guide plan-review says to run session done as its own command once findings, verdict or the reviser's apply succeeded, never chained with ';'; workflow describe plan shows the critic prompt with the same instruction; plan.toml and plan-milestone.toml review, critic and revise prompts carry it.
